comment: Only active rejected records are excluded from discovery. Textual overlap is allowed in the catalogue; deduplication applies separately to the Renascor Corpus. Review-pending records preserve earlier decisions for reconsideration and are not excluded from discovery.

review_pending.title: Digital Latin Library — Library of Digital Latin Texts (LDLT)
review_pending.previous_reason: Federates texts published elsewhere: the words it adds cannot be counted exactly, and they cannot be shown not to be in the catalogue already.
review_pending.reason: The overlap-based exclusion was withdrawn. Review whether this resource provides its own identifiable text collection and establish its 1450–1700 counts and coverage before adding a record.
